description: This script filters a list of files based on their extensions, distinguishing files suitable for linting or formatting in a pre-commit hook. It outputs NUL-delimited filenames that match target extensions depending on the mode ('lint' or 'format').

methods.name: shouldSelect
methods.description: Determines if a given file should be included based on its extension and the current mode ('lint' or 'format'). Uses predefined sets of extensions for each mode.
